body: Reference image is identity/style only. Generate a production pixel-art animation spritesheet for Bullets of Fury Stage 5 Chrome Hammer Archmage transforming into CRAZED MINIGUN SPACE BLASTER MODE. Exactly EIGHT complete robot BODY poses in a single horizontal row, equally spaced, transparent background, no text. Consistent crisp 16-bit arcade metallic black/chrome armor, blue violet energy core, recognizable helmet. NO cape, NO hammer, NO back gun, NO guns drawn into any body frame. A giant modular rotary cannon will be composited separately between his hands along the vertical centerline, pointing straight SOUTH toward the bottom of screen. Body faces viewer/south, modest elevated shmup view. Frame1 regular upright robot, empty hands near hips; frame2 shoulders lift and armor splits; frame3 shoulder plates flare sideways and torso compresses; frame4 mechanical armor expands into heavy bulky siege armor, legs tuck slightly; frame5 wide heavily armored stance, both hands grip invisible side handles near lower belly; frame6 fully transformed broad menacing blaster chassis with huge flared shoulders, strong braced legs, hands at identical matching weapon handles; frame7 same final body compressed slightly from firing recoil, core brighter; frame8 same final body enraged and braced, violet vents bright. Keep core center and hand sockets consistent across final three frames. Shapeshifting mechanical silhouette change is substantial but still same character. Frame margins generous, every pose fully isolated, never touching neighbor, no ground or effects.
gun: Reference is color/material style only. Generate a separate MODULAR giant rotary CHAINGUN spritesheet for this black/chrome blue-core robot, 16-bit arcade pixel art, exactly EIGHT complete isolated gun frames in one horizontal row on genuine transparent background. NO robot, NO hands, NO character, NO labels, NO floor. Critical orientation: every gun long axis is EXACTLY VERTICAL, receiver at TOP/NORTH, long six-barrel cluster pointing straight DOWN/SOUTH to screen bottom. Elevated overhead view so long barrels are visible, NOT a gun aimed out of the image into viewer, not diagonal or sideways. Compact boxy rear receiver with violet-blue energy core and two small horizontal side grips near the top; oversized six-barrel dark steel Gatling cluster descends from it. Matching mounting point receiver center, consistent scale. Frames1-4 cold spinning barrel orientations, distinct rotor positions, same stationary receiver, no muzzle flash baked in. Frames5-6 barrels glowing red-orange from overheating, still violet receiver, no flame or smoke baked in. Frame7 heavily damaged cracked barrel housing with missing armor but still attached. Frame8 destroyed broken receiver stub with jagged barrel fragments detached just below, contained within own frame; no explosion baked in. Highly graphical detailed gleaming steel, heavy black outlines, readable pixel clusters, clean silhouette, enough blank gap between assets for slicing, all entire weapons and fragments inside each cell.
effects: Create a game VFX spritesheet for the Chrome Hammer Archmage's crazed rotary energy chaingun. Crisp graphical 16-bit arcade pixel art, dark blue outlines, electric blue-white cores and violet edges, matching metallic black/blue science fiction shmup. Exactly EIGHT isolated effects in ONE horizontal row with equal-width cells and generous transparent gaps, actual transparent background, no text, no weapons, no robots. Frame1 small downward-pointing blue-white muzzle flash, frame2 larger down-facing jagged muzzle flash, frame3 largest forked downward flash, frame4 compact contracting down-facing flash. All four begin at a narrow emission point at TOP and fan out toward BOTTOM, same source anchor. Frame5 separate elongated energy bullet with bright pointed nose at BOTTOM and thin blue/violet trailing sparks ABOVE; frame6 second animation frame of exactly same downward bullet. Frame7 small cooling steam puff in blue-gray-white drifting upward, frame8 wider dissipating cooling steam puff. Sharp pixel clusters and clean alpha edges, no giant blurred halos. Every sprite fully visible, cells do not overlap. Muzzle flashes are short explosive bursts not long laser beams.
